HSBC is one of the world’s leading international banks, with a network spanning 56 countries and territories. You’ll strengthen your understanding of team dynamics and learn how to contribute effectively to high-performing teams through development sessions, practical experience and coaching.

Four six-month placements will provide you with broad exposure to IWPB and specialist knowledge of the Bank’s Qatar operations. Placement opportunities will be aligned with your interests, capabilities and career aspirations, subject to business requirements.
